title: Queen Behind Bishop
setup: Your queen on c1 is aimed up the c-file, and your own bishop on c4 is the only thing blocking it.
hint: Where can the bishop go so that it opens the file and starts eyeing something on the eighth rank?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Bb5+}} unmasks the queen's check up the c-file and takes aim at e8 along b5-c6-d7 at the same time. Black must answer the check first, so after Kd8 the bishop collects the queen. Blocking with Qc6 only hands it over a move sooner.
